# I have the access token. Now let me get the current song and check if it's liked. I'll loop through songs until I find a liked one.

    song_id = current_song["song_id"]
    
    privates = apis.spotify.show_song_privates(song_id=song_id, access_token=access_token)
    print("Privates:", privates)
    
    if privates["liked"]:
        print("Found a liked song!")
        break
    
    next_response = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next:", next_response)
